claim: One Pi Durable session takes turns from raw TCP and from a browser at the same time; each side sees the other's turns; a reconnect on either side loses no turns.
scope: local wrangler dev, Workers AI binding (remote)

checks.name: browser socket with a bad token is refused
browser sees a turn asked over TCP
browser sees the reply to the TCP turn
TCP sees a turn asked from the browser
TCP sees the reply to the browser turn
TCP reconnect replays the turn it missed
browser reconnect replays the turn it missed
history is ordered with no duplicates
history holds all four user turns
